source_caption_text:
How did Chris Brown keep a straight face while Drake was hitting those dance moves 😂💀

The “No Guidance” video is still hilarious, especially when Chris Brown starts dancing like he’s about to win the whole battle. Drake’s reaction makes it even better, just standing there looking genuinely unimpressed and hitting him with that sarcastic “Ooo wow.”

Then Drake steps up thinking he can actually compete and starts doing some of the most ridiculous dance moves imaginable. The confidence makes it even funnier because he’s moving like he really thinks he’s hitting it while Chris is standing there barely taking him seriously.

And the funniest part might be when Drake’s own crew starts slowly walking away from the situation. They see him getting cooked and basically decide they want no part of it, leaving Drake out there by himself before he finally admits Chris is the better dancer.
